message.content: {"note_claim": "The 62 million visits were to the larger aggregator website (Motherless.com) that linked to the group, not to the Telegram group itself.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The website, which had around 62 million visits in February alone and whose core audience is in the United States, describes itself as a \"moral free file host where anything legal is hosted forever.\"", "reason": "The page attributes the ~62 million visits to Motherless.com, and separately says a Motherless user linked to the \"Zzz\" Telegram group (nearly a thousand users), confirming the figure refers to the larger site, not the group."}
